Strong CFO is not alone proof all capex earns its cost of capital.
key_risks: Large borrowings plus leases and heavy capital spend.
Bottom line earnings decline, FXvolatility and tariff/fuel adjustment timing; post financing dividend coverage narrow.
key_strengths: CFO11.9525 bn coverscashPP&E and modest investment property spend.
H1operating profitgrew andliquidity/net current liabilities improved.
fundamentals.summary: Tenaga’s full cash flow statement verifies funding capacity for investment anddividends, correcting the earlier extraction gap. Neutral/medium balances that cash strength against high lease-inclusive debt, profit decline and regulated return uncertainty at the frozen valuation.
